reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of all 18 B1/B2 adjective/adverb questions: full German sentences, inflection, every offered distractor, single answer, bilingual feedback, context variation and provenance. Corrected inherited gloss and sense issues for zufällig, zumutbar, zusammenfassend and zuständig. Existing GM2 draft/production objectives checked; no same assessable objective identified. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval remain pending. Reworded zufällig variant 2 to natural random-order wording after editorial review.
